gen-dafont-college-fs-synonym: Synonym lays down a plain stripe of ink with generous openings in every curve, and it sits low beside its tall-lowercase heading. Synonym keeps paragraphs moving without a snag, while College does the shouting.
gen-dafont-college-gf-almendra: College hits hard, every curve as thick as its stems, while Almendra's deep-bellied lowercase sits low and bookish beneath it. Pen-drawn force meets text serif warmth.
gen-dafont-college-gf-bree-serif: College draws its tall lowercase with no modulation at all, a marker-like authority that Bree Serif softens with outsized, literary proportions. One commands; the other settles in.
gen-dafont-college-gf-quando: Wide, sparse spacing and a tall middle zone make Quando read slowly and traditionally, in contrast to College's tall, marker-thick lines. College is built to announce; Quando to be lingered over.
gen-dafont-college-outfit: Every curve in College is as thick as its straight stems, with big counters. Outfit bends cable-like lines into curves that stop short of closing, so it handles the quieter reading while College carries the dynamic, authoritative voice.
gen-dafont-college-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans reads modern and precise, its monoline curves ending well apart from one another. And since College's lowercase stands taller, giving the body font a little more size helps the two meet.
gen-dafont-conthrax-fs-amulya: Conthrax traces every stroke at the width of one stylus, with a wide-mouthed a and lowercase so tall the capitals barely rise above it. Amulya's generous gaps make it the easy-going partner.
gen-dafont-conthrax-fs-chillax: Relaxed is the first word for Chillax, whose spaghetti-like line leaves its loops unfinished. Chillax loosens up the geometric, tall-bodied Conthrax, so the page moves from rigid to easy.
gen-dafont-conthrax-fs-plein: Reliable describes Plein, which leads a clear channel into each round letter and sits lower than its heading. The pairing's strength is that Conthrax's geometric precision gets a steady partner.
gen-dafont-conthrax-fs-roundo: Roundo reads neutral and geometric, its n matching arch to stem and every small counter left unclogged. Roundo's moderate lowercase height gives Conthrax, with its tall single-thread bodies, a lower, calmer counterpart.
